name: iPhone Use
description: Live iPhone preview on desktop and mobile, with bounded Phone Use Agent observation and actions through an existing local PUA service.
whenToUse: When the user asks to inspect or operate their connected iPhone, view its screen, find an accessibility control, tap, type or navigate an app.

tools.name: adapter_status
tools.description: Report local bridge/configuration availability without contacting the iPhone or starting PUA.

tools.name: ready
tools.description: Check the existing PUA service, unlocked phone and accessibility observation. No automatic setup or restart. Only ready=true permits actions.

screenshot.description: Also verify screenshot; false retains status/session/source/viewport/unlock checks.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Read the current iPhone accessibility tree or an explicit screenshot. The returned image_url is a Cindy media image when deposit succeeds; image.path is a fallback local evidence path.

mode.description: Standalone observation output, default tree. Use mode here; observe is a post-action option on mutation tools. none is not a standalone observation mode.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find accessibility controls by selector without modifying the phone.

label.description: Exact accessibility label copied from fresh nodes; real newlines and punctuation are preserved automatically.

label_contains.description: Substring of the label, for long or changing labels. Case-sensitive, encoded safely.

name.description: Exact accessibility identifier/name. Nodes omit name when it equals label.

value.description: Exact current accessibility value; not the text to enter. Omit values that change asynchronously.

type.description: Exact element type as nodes show it, e.g. Button. Not an application bundle ID.

enabled.description: Optional exact enabled filter. This does not prove hittability.

index.description: 0-based position among the matches in tree order, as listed by pua_find or an ambiguous_target error. Only to choose between several matches.

predicate.description: Advanced NSPredicate query used alone (index may accompany it). Prefer the exact fields so text is safely encoded.

selector.description: Exact label/name/value/type/enabled fields or label_contains, or a standalone predicate. rect, visible and in_viewport are observation fields, not selector fields. Matches nested at one place, or with only one on screen, resolve to that element; several separate matches return candidates with tap points and an index.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap once using a fresh selector or point coordinates; uncertain outcomes must be observed before another mutation.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Make one directional gesture, then observe if the next choice needs page state.

direction.description: Finger movement; up usually reveals later rows. Default up.

region.description: Scroll rectangle in iPhone points, not screenshot pixels. observation_id is optional. Omit region for the central area, or use the actual list bounds. With verify=true, the region must fit current viewport and native modal bounds.

tools.description: Pause/resume the preview during authentication; the right panel opens independently. Never show a secret or passcode to the model.

action.description: Default open displays the live iPhone sidebar. Pause before password/Face ID takeover; resume only after the user confirms completion.
